purpose: Operator-supplied candidate validation state for V1/M1 end-to-end runtime validation.
raw_input_policy: Supply these exact files ephemerally to the cloud/runtime task; do not commit them to the public repository.

provenance.description: Maintainer-created ordinary-game state using the canonical Antagonizer target. No cheats, save editing, or guest-memory modification were reported.

pair_observation.interpretation: The two files share byte-identical content from 0x73 through EOF. No semantic meaning is assigned to the differing header bytes.

must_verify_at_runtime_before_v1_use: the attached file hash and size match this manifest
the save loads under the canonical target
the player is the intended race/internal id for the V1 scenario
at least two distinct player-owned planets exist; prefer all three reported planets
at least one player-owned planet has the internal empty/no-current-action state
the chosen scripted start has no blocking modal and is timing-stable enough for the V1 action sequence
